notes.title: Language Update - French
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

Moral King is now also playable with French subtitles.

We wish you lots of fun with Moral King.

Many Greetings
Tim & Mark

notes.title: Moral King takes part in the Steam Fall Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

since you all liked Moral King, when you grabbed it during the recent discount, we are happy to announce that we are once again lowering the price for you in the Steam Fall Sale.

Thank you for all the feedback that you have given us. We wish you a happy fall sale and much fun with Moral King.

Many greetings
Tim and Mark

notes.title: Discount for Moral King!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

until the 14th of November our discount promotion is running, in which we grant a discount of 70% on Moral King.

We hope you enjoy the game. In addition, we are happy about any honest reviews. So if you could  spare a few minutes to rate, we would be very happy.



Thanks and many greetings

Tim and Mark

notes.title: Save & Skip - Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, so we just released the first big update for moral king. Now it is possible to skip longer video parts, so that you don't have to see them again, if made a wrong choice.

Further we added a autosave system that will save the game when you reach an idle scene. You can load the latest save in the main menu.

We hope you have fun with Moral King :-)

Best regards
Tim & Mark

notes.title: UI-Graphics Update
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

we have just released a small update that brings all UI elements to a consistent style.

This includes on the one hand the appearance of buttons, as well as the application of a medieval font on all texts.

Have fun with Moral King and best regards
Tim and Mark

notes.title: Moral King is released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Moral King is released on Steam. A student project has made it to a commercial release. To this point, it was a hard and sweaty road, from which we have now reached the end.

We hope you like our small, interactive movie. If you want to know more about the development, let us know here in the comments.

Until then we wish you much fun with Moral King.

Best regards
Mark and Tim

notes.title: Moral King released for all curators.
notes.notes:
Moral King has been released today for all curators.

Thus, each curator our little Indi Game project is available. We hope that some open and honest reviews are written and that our game gives you pleasure.

Best regards
Mark and Tim
